ambient_events: The autocannon traverses on its dead-truck mount with a tortured metal shriek.
Belt links glint in a heap where the grass has been beaten flat.
Heat-shimmer wobbles off the barrel long after the last burst.
description: A wastes gun nest bodged together on the open pasture — an autocannon bolted to the bed of a dead truck, sandbagged around and open to the whole sky. It's scavenged, jury-rigged, and mean, traversed by hand and fed by whoever's nearest. A hatch cut into a buried container beside the truck drops into the bunker where the spares and the belts are hoarded out of the sun.
name: Wastes Gun Nest
